open_decisions.label: installation_namespace_global_registry
open_decisions.evidence: Immutable 2–32 safe-character unique namespace across all client installations; not derive from DB/domain

open_decisions.label: field_minimization_and_processing_purpose
open_decisions.evidence: Written necessity and lawful basis for each customer/order field; emails/names and raw flags separately reviewed

open_decisions.label: timezone_historical_storage_provenance
open_decisions.evidence: Current Europe/Madrid verified; actual historical DATETIME semantics and DST ambiguous rows not verified

open_decisions.label: record_modified_and_refresh_mode
open_decisions.evidence: Choose v0.2 without date-time or v0.3 UTC field with proven provenance; approve stale update behavior before streams

open_decisions.label: categories_pk_and_data_space
open_decisions.evidence: Confirm Profile/Other, source_key, default space and exact tenant mapping

open_decisions.label: dlo_dmo_mapping_and_order_relationship
open_decisions.evidence: Confirm customer/order Data Lake → Data Model mappings; cart is reference only

open_decisions.label: retention_erasure_and_deletion
open_decisions.evidence: Define actual retention/erasure and suppression lifecycle; no invented number of days

open_decisions.label: final_yaml_hash_and_salesforce_preview
open_decisions.evidence: Pin exact YAML SHA256 and review Salesforce preview before separate upload authorization

PSCustomer.name: source_key
PSCustomer.review_note: Proposed PK; must be globally stable by installation/shop/customer. Never dedupe by email.

PSCustomer.name: source_namespace
PSCustomer.review_note: Proposed immutable merchant installation namespace; registry and format not signed off.

PSCustomer.name: shop_id
PSCustomer.review_note: Shop-scoped PrestaShop ID, not globally unique.

PSCustomer.name: customer_id
PSCustomer.review_note: Per-shop source ID; never a Salesforce ID.

PSCustomer.name: email
PSCustomer.review_note: Optional in source schema; lawful purpose, contact suppression, retention and mapping need approval.

PSCustomer.name: newsletter_flag
PSCustomer.review_note: PrestaShop source flag is not permission to send; purpose, provenance and Growth suppression unresolved.

PSCustomer.name: partner_optin_flag
PSCustomer.review_note: Partner offers flag; never infer first-party cart recovery marketing consent.

PSCustomer.name: active_flag
PSCustomer.review_note: PrestaShop customer active, not Salesforce campaign activation.

PSCustomer.name: source_updated_local
PSCustomer.review_note: Timezone and DST provenance unknown; TEXT only, never Record Modified.

PSCustomer.name: source_updated_utc
PSCustomer.review_note: v0.3 only; historical offset and DST must be audited before conversion/Record Modified.

PSOrder.name: source_key
PSOrder.review_note: Proposed PK; installation + shop + order ID.

PSOrder.name: source_namespace
PSOrder.review_note: Same immutable namespace as linked customer.

PSOrder.name: shop_id
PSOrder.review_note: Source shop ID; cross-installation collision protection required.

PSOrder.name: order_id
PSOrder.review_note: Source order identifier, not Salesforce CRM ID.

PSOrder.name: customer_source_key
PSOrder.review_note: Must resolve inside same installation/shop. No relation inferred by email.

PSOrder.name: cart_source_key
PSOrder.review_note: Reference only; there is no approved PSCartEvent stream.

PSOrder.name: total_paid
PSOrder.review_note: Commercial totals; lawful basis, retention, taxes/precision and DMO mapping pending.

PSOrder.name: state_id
PSOrder.review_note: Native order status ID, not cross-shop semantic status without mapping.

PSOrder.name: source_updated_local
PSOrder.review_note: Timezone/DST provenance unknown. No ordering/Record Modified use.

PSOrder.name: source_updated_utc
PSOrder.review_note: v0.3 only; must not be derived from historical local time without provenance.

notes: 12 candidate fields per object, 11 in v0.2 baseline; none approved to upload.
newsletter_flag and partner_optin_flag are raw source attributes, not marketing authorization.
source_updated_utc is v0.3 candidate only and is NOT derived from actual historical BC data.
No legitimate basis, retention number or mapping is claimed by offline schema CI.
